'''2002 Coruscant Regionals''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG regional in 2002. [[Chris Wodicka]] finished 6th (out of 36) with a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Imperial Siege|ISB Operations]] list (''6th place Coruscant regionals'').<ref name="dt-23830">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830 6th place Coruscant regionals], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 8 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23830/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23830/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009115058/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' June 2002
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
